LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we read using technology? 2. How do you search for information using technology?

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read animated stories, comics and cartoons interpretively, individually and collaboratively with peers,

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
